description: Rumbal operations memory in Spanish: latency budgets, storage units, retention, gateway timeouts, retries, paging and the search 2.4 rollout. Evidence is the SLO note, ADR-015, superseded ADR-008, the 2026-09-18 capacity note, the on-call runbook and the version notes. Hard parts: unit and percent paraphrases, search versus billing scope, a 105-day gap stated only as two dates, a patch-versus-minor mistake, and modality (no se debe, ya no, únicamente cuando, solo).
